During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''weapon''' of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] origin was being sold by a [[Unidentified black market dealer|black market dealer]] in the [[Zarkis system/Legends|Zarkis system]]. An [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] team was dispatched to secure it.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
